Current purchasesXstatus literal is absent in the82-body scan; inventory holds general module consumers, not captured current grid trigger binding.

steps: Read writable ILastSearchDataModelRuntime and menu search/model metadata; absent search attribute→return.

Read selected aggregate condition slots in numeric order. Keep all non-date axes; among $$date/$$date_no/$$date_record_seq_no select one by priority summary_line→summary_slip→day→week→month→quarter→half→year.
If standalone comparison_period refer value !=string0 and clicked record/prop_index identifies comparison cell, write compare.from/to date range into writable last-search model.
Build aggregate filters from clicked DMC values. No clicked-column-specific axis narrowing occurs: all selected eligible axes are considered.

If main_viewer_id exists delete aggregate property to preserve target submenu server defaults; otherwise mutate aggregate with comparison_period0, default aggregate_key and details_target=line props from renderer metadata. Existing extra fields are retained by Object.assign.
Overlay generated axis filters after the comparison date assignment. A generated date-axis filter can replace that date range.
Resolve target page/menu (referrer, parent set-menu notification, URL mapping or current identifier fallback). SumStatus search model ID is renamed to Status.
Only when target_menu_type truthy openPopupAsync viewer_version V5 with lifecycle load_complete ISelectStatusUserAction(search_type HEADER), search_data_model and use_default_preset=false.

rules: Refer-type mapping must be nonempty before item-meaning override can take effect. summary_trx_001..005 override to inv_s$conn_data_001..005; summary_multi_trx_001..005 to inv_m$conn_data_001..005.

For target $$multi_code: only nonempty clicked value.code adds [value]. Blank code produces no overlay for that property; any existing last-search filter therefore survives unless another path changes it.

For target $$date_range_condition: read clicked row data_dt_no.data_dt and convert by date refer type. No null/data_dt_no validation in this helper; missing synthetic-row fields may fail or leave behavior external.
Target $$date has no write in this switch. Other target types copy raw clicked value, including undefined. Same-target filters later in reducer can overwrite earlier ones.
No explicit Boolean AND/OR predicate is constructed. Multiple property filters are passed together; backend semantics and SID/code/name equivalence are unknown.
Existing last-search predicates remain unless overwritten. This is not a fresh unrestricted query generated from a displayed caption.

facts: summary_slip and summary_line both map to inv_s$data_dt. Their date conversion falls through to same-date from/to. This helper does not add data_no,record_seq_no,data_sid or record_sid restrictions. No exact-document/line drilldown guarantee follows.

Day:base date only; month:first..last calendar day; quarter:Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct1 through quarter end; half:Jan1..Jun30 orJul1..Dec31; year:YYYY0101..YYYY1231. These are clicked-row query filters, not ordinary aggregate bucket/server-key proof.
Week helper is local Sunday..Saturday using Date.getDay(), not proof of original ordinary ISO/company week aggregation.
Only the single prioritized date axis is applied. No explicit intersection with the prior search date range is performed in this helper; it overlays the target date property.
